claim_boundary: Lower long-term real discount rates provide a plausible risk-asset valuation channel, and monetary-policy surprise studies sometimes find negative BTC responses to tightening. Other primary empirical work finds Bitcoin largely orthogonal to macroeconomic and monetary news. Exactly one preregistered matched-capital audit may test whether a four-week decline in the official ten-year TIPS real yield improves DRA entry economics; no causal or alpha claim is imported from the literature.

feature_contract.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED
feature_contract.source_agency: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US)

prior_matrix.identity: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, ten-year inflation-indexed Treasury constant maturity yield via FRED
prior_matrix.finding: The official DFII10 series is a daily market yield on ten-year inflation-indexed Treasury securities, quoted on an investment basis in percent, not seasonally adjusted, sourced from the Federal Reserve H.15 release and tagged Public Domain: Citation Requested.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: DFII10 is a smoothed constant-maturity market estimate, not an exogenous policy surprise, direct funding rate or Bitcoin-specific discount rate.

prior_matrix.identity: Kyriazis, Ofeidis, Palaiokrassas and Tassiulas, Monetary Policy, Digital Assets, and DeFi Activity (2023)
prior_matrix.finding: The event-study evidence reports that unexpected U.S. monetary-policy tightening negatively affects BTC and ETH returns and increases digital-asset volatility around FOMC communications.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A high-frequency surprise is not a four-week trend in a ten-year real yield, and the study does not validate DRA admission, after-cost economics or weekly predictability.

prior_matrix.identity: Benigno and Rosa, The Bitcoin-Macro Disconnect, Federal Reserve Bank of New York Staff Report 1052 (2023)
prior_matrix.finding: The paper derives a real-interest-rate discounting channel for a speculative asset but empirically finds Bitcoin largely unresponsive to short-rate surprises and most macroeconomic news, with future-policy-path sensitivity not robust.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The theoretical discount-rate sign is insufficient when the measured Bitcoin response is unstable. Only matched-capital Design and Validation evidence can rescue this exact weekly rule.

prior_matrix.identity: Karau, Monetary policy and Bitcoin, Journal of International Money and Finance 137 (2023)
prior_matrix.finding: Bitcoin's response to U.S. monetary tightening changes over time and became more similar to conventional risky assets in the later sample.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Regime-varying responses can make a fixed four-week real-yield sign fail annual breadth even if aggregate correlation appears favorable.

real_time_design_requirements: Seal exact annual FRED CSV responses for DFII10 from 2018-01-01 through 2024-12-31; require unique weekday dates, signed finite decimal values and explicit holiday blanks.
Construct each calendar week ending Friday from all available Monday-Friday observations; require three to five observations and do not interpolate holidays.
Make week-ending Friday D usable only at D plus five calendar days 00:00 UTC and valid for at most 168 hours.
Compare each weekly mean only with the exact weekly mean 28 calendar days earlier; admit the unchanged DRA V1 signal only when the current mean is strictly lower.
Use the frozen 250 USDT DRA V1 parent, 240 USDT slot capacity, 0.10% fee and 0.05% adverse slippage without changing entries, exits, lot size, capacity or accounting.

Require Design, Validation, 2020-2024 annual matched-capital economics, realized/unrealized/total PnL, drawdown, underwater duration, holding, utilization, terminal inventory, intervention breadth, concentration and independent non-overlapping 168-hour predictive diagnostics.

Do not add nominal yields, breakeven inflation, yield-curve spreads, Fed balance sheet, dollar index, policy-event dummies, 1/8/13/26/52-week horizons, moving averages, level thresholds, z-scores, magnitude cutoffs, inverse rules, fractional sizing, short legs or post-outcome exceptions.
Do not reinterpret the closed Treasury term-spread, broad-dollar, Fed balance-sheet or NFCI branches as support. They use different mechanisms and remain permanently closed.
Do not open post-2024 data; a historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires separately sealed independent OOS.
uncertainty: DFII10 is a fitted constant-maturity TIPS market yield and can reflect growth, inflation-risk, liquidity and term-premium changes in addition to real discount rates.
Bitcoin-macro sensitivity is time-varying and may be weak or absent outside policy-announcement windows.
The present-vintage FRED series can contain revisions; original H.15 release values and revision history remain MISSING_PROOF.
The four-week horizon is a preregistered monthly-scale convention, not a parameter established by the cited papers.
No complete DFII10 history, BTC/DRA outcome, post-2024 observation, candidate, OOS or Trading path was accessed while freezing this prior.
